violation_type.title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §747.3301(6))
violation_type.short_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that diaper changing supplies were in which of children.

finding_variants.text: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that diaper changing supplies were in which of children.
Diaper changing supplies such as wipes and creams were seen on the side of bathtub in childrens reach. This was corrected at inspection when the Primary caregiver moved the basket to a higher shelf.

CCR observed lotion, diaper rash cream, gel, and baby wipes below the diaper changing table, which was open and accessible to the children.        Correction made: The provider removed the diaper supplies from underneath the diaper changing table.
